proposed_ideas.title: Reklamny film ako kod - co to robi s produkciou vizualov
proposed_ideas.note: Cleevio 'Video as code' (6.10., Petr Had). Atomika film: ~62 s, 16 scen, 100 BPM, 125 agentov (4 priprava, 14 kreativa, 72 produkcia, 35 QA), 8,5 h od briefu po hotovy film a web, ~4 h ludskeho casu. Cleevio teaser: ~18 s, 11 scen, 120 BPM, 105 agentov, prvy rough cut ~3 h, finalne ~6,5 h. Claude Code s Claude Opus 5.5, Figma brand assety, Suno na hudbu, Canvas a WebGL render v prehliadaci, jeden MacBook. Cenu neuvadzaju. Uhol: deterministicky re-render vs. generativne video, a kde zostava clovek (sami priznavaju, ze zvukovy mix musel posudit clovek).

proposed_ideas.title: Pristupnost stala 220 riadkov - vlastne cislo
proposed_ideas.note: Futured (12.10., Jakub Marek): iROZHLAS 6.1.0, ~220 riadkov kodu, 23 suborov, 2 PR, ziadny refactor, ~1 tyzden aj s manualnym QA. Appka 4,7* z 2200+ hodnoteni, ~80 000 MAU. Doplnili vysokokontrastne varianty tokenov, odlisenie nie len farbou, reduced motion, Apple Accessibility Nutrition Labels. Teza: 'Pristupnost je downstream efekt upstream discipliny' - design tokeny, systemove komponenty a VoiceOver akceptacne kriteria od zaciatku. Pokuty do 10 mil. CZK, existujuce sluzby do 28.6.2030. V sete to riesi Touch4IT (7.9.), Ackee (20.7.), Panaxeo (2025), Futured - na nasom blogu nic viditelne.

proposed_ideas.title: Co sa stane s QA timom, ked pridu automaticke testy
proposed_ideas.note: STRV, Ada Hub pre Warner Music Group (Michal Stanek, Gabriel Pavlik). Playwright, GitHub CI na kazdy build + denna regresia. Cisla: release 2 tyzdne -> 5 dni, plna regresia 3+ dni -> 20 minut, 90 %+ kritickych user journeys, ~50 % viac bugov pred produkciou, 10 000+ MAU, ~30 inzinierov. Po 18 mesiacoch dalsie skratenie na polovicu. Neobsadene: zo 7 manualnych testerov zostali 2 automatizacni, zvysok presiel na exploratory testing. O cycle time pisu vsetci, o ludoch nikto. POZOR: STRV nema datumy v HTML, vek kusu neovereny.
